linkFallback: If the button does not work, copy and paste this link into your browser:

verifyEmail.subject: Verify your SellPointy account
verifyEmail.body: Thanks for signing up to SellPointy. Confirm your email to activate your account.
verifyEmail.expiry: This link expires in 24 hours. If you didn't create this account, ignore this email.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your SellPointy password
resetPassword.body: We received a request to reset your password.
resetPassword.expiry: This link expires in 30 minutes. If you didn't request this, ignore this email.

inviteUser.subject: You've been invited to SellPointy
inviteUser.body: You were added to SellPointy. Follow the link to set your password and activate your account.
inviteUser.expiry: This link expires in 7 days. If you weren't expecting this invitation, ignore this email.

paymentReceived.subject: We received your SellPointy payment
paymentReceived.body: We recorded your payment of {amount} for the {planName} plan of {tenantName}. Your service is covered until {periodEnd}. Thanks for trusting SellPointy!

trialEnding.subject: Your SellPointy trial ends in {daysLeft} days
trialEnding.body: The free trial of {tenantName} (full Plus plan) ends on {deadline}. To continue without interruptions, get your plan before that date — otherwise your account will switch to free mode: you can view everything and make up to 10 sales a day.

trialEnded.subject: Your SellPointy trial ended — your data is still here
trialEnded.body: The trial of {tenantName} ended and your account switched to free mode: you can log in, view everything and make up to 10 sales a day. Nothing was deleted. When you get a plan, everything comes back instantly.

paymentDueSoon.subject: Your SellPointy plan is due on {deadline}
paymentDueSoon.body: The {planName} plan of {tenantName} is due on {deadline}. Make your payment before that date to continue without interruptions.

paymentPastDue.subject: We did not receive your SellPointy payment
paymentPastDue.body: The {planName} plan of {tenantName} was due on {deadline} and we have not recorded your payment. You have {daysLeft} days to catch up; afterwards your account will switch to free mode (view-only plus 10 sales a day). Your data is not deleted.

planDowngraded.subject: Your SellPointy account switched to free mode
planDowngraded.body: The grace period of {tenantName} ended and your account switched to free mode: you can view everything and make up to 10 sales a day. Nothing was deleted — once your payment is recorded, your plan comes back instantly.
